subject: Post-call: Lumenix cost runway, $/1M target & multi-year incentive path
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@lumenix.com>
Cc: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@lumenix.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap + asks (token run-rate, target $/1M, timeline)

Samir / Elena — great conversation earlier, thanks for taking the time. Quick recap + the things we promised to confirm so you can take this to procurement: 

1) What we heard (short):
- Primary use: user-facing semantic search + summarization for Lumenix insights (low-latency fragments + batched nightly embedding jobs).
- Current pilot: ~25M tokens / month today (ingest + runtime), expecting to ramp to 120–150M tokens / month within 9–12 months if feature rollout goes well.
- Critical constraints: predictable unit cost and data isolation for PII-heavy sources.

2) Asks we need from you to size pricing/discount path (please reply inline):
- Monthly run-rate range: Low / Expected / High (tokens per month)
- Target unit economics: what $/1M tokens would make a committed path viable for you? (ballpark is fine)
- Procurement timeline: when will procurement/security/PO be ready to engage?

3) What we can offer now (high level):
- Startup program credits (short-term ramp support), plus a structured committed-use discount ladder (12m / 24m) with additional multi-year incentive for volume growth clauses.
- Security: we can bring Neha (security/compliance) into the procurement thread for any SOC2/KMS questions.

Next steps: please fill the attached run_rate_template.csv with the three-month and 12-month projection (low/expected/high) and reply. Once we have that, I’ll loop in Ben (cc’d) to produce a pricing sketch and a draft quote.

Attachments: run_rate_template.csv (template for monthly token projections)

Thanks — ava

--
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0189

Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + asks (token run-rate, target $/1M, timeline)

Ava — thanks for the succinct recap. Filling in the asks below: 

- Monthly run-rate (tokens): Low = 20M, Expected = 60M, High = 150M (we expect step function growth when we open to additional customers in Q3).
- Target $/1M tokens: Our CFO wants to keep infra spend under $0.5M / month while we scale; rough internal target is $300–$450 per 1M tokens depending on support/SLA.
- Procurement timeline: Security kickoff next week (week of 2/23), procurement/finance will be able to review commercial terms in the week of 3/2. Legal will need a draft SoW/PO and standard MSAs to start redlines.

We are very interested in the startup program you mentioned — we are still seed but closing a bridge round late March so any upfront credits + a clear committed path to reduce unit price would be extremely helpful. Can you provide an example of the committed tiers (rough $/1M after discount) and what multi-year incentive structure looks like? Also, please share the list of required artifacts for the compliance review (SOC2, data residency statements).

Thanks — Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Product, Lumenix
samir.patel@lumenix.com

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + asks (token run-rate, target $/1M, timeline)

Thanks for the details, Samir — that helps a lot. I’ve put together a short pricing sketch and attachment for the startup + committed paths; see notes below and attached proposed_pricing.xlsx and the startup_program_terms.pdf. Ben (cc) will formalize the quote once you confirm the run-rate sheet. Neha, thanks in advance for joining the compliance thread — can you confirm the baseline artifacts we should surface to Lumenix?

High level pricing sketch (illustrative, pre-negotiation):
- Hosted pay-as-you-go (no commit): ~$1,000 / 1M tokens (baseline for our larger LLMs) — not the direction for Lumenix if you want predictable runway.
- Startup program package (seed-stage): 3-month $25k credit + 30% off months 4–9 if you enroll and provide company verification. After credits/discounts, close-term effective price can drop into the $400–$650 / 1M range depending on model mix and batching.
- Committed use example (annualized):
  * 12-month, 6B tokens/yr (~500k tokens/mo avg): 18% discount off list => illustrative $820 / 1M
  * 12-month, 36B tokens/yr (~3M tokens/mo avg): 20–22% discount => illustrative $780 / 1M
  * 24-month, 36B tokens/yr: 28% discount + growth rebate clause => illustrative ~$560–$650 / 1M after incentives (depends on realized growth).

Notes on hitting $300–$450 target: to get into the mid-$300s per 1M we typically require a multi-year committed volume plus usage optimization (KV caching, quantized model variants for specific paths, and routing lower-critical paths to cheaper model variants). The proposed_pricing.xlsx includes sample blended $/1M outputs given your three run-rate scenarios.

Compliance artifacts (Neha, pls confirm):
- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted)
- Data processing addendum / KMS details
- Network diagrams for Private/VPC (if relevant)
- Short control summary (encryption, retention, access logging)

Attachments: proposed_pricing.xlsx, startup_program_terms.pdf

If this looks reasonable, Samir, can you confirm the run_rate_template.csv and we’ll produce a formal quote and a DocuSign link for the startup enrollment + committed term outline.

Best — ava

Subject: Lumenix — draft commercial path & next procurement steps

Samir — looping in a short commercial checklist and next steps from our side. Thanks for the run-rate numbers; they map cleanly into two viable options: (A) short-term startup enrollment + 6–12 month ramp credits, or (B) upfront committed use with a multi-year rebate. 

Quick checklist we need to move to a draft quote/PO: 
- Confirm expected 12-month average monthly tokens (you gave Low/Expected/High; pick the one you want the quote to be anchored to).
- Confirm whether Lumenix can commit to an annual minimum (we recommend starting with a 12m commit with an uplift to 24m if you hit growth thresholds).
- Procurement contact for billing/PO — you can loop in procurement@lumenix.com (cc’d).
- Security artifacts: Neha will send the SOC2 packet and DPA template.

Commercial note (illustrative):
- If you anchor to 60M/month (Expected) and sign a 24-month committed plan with the growth rebate structure, we can show an illustrative blended unit of ~$520 / 1M in year 1 and ~420 / 1M in year 2 contingent on growth thresholds. Final numbers will be in the quote.

Next steps: if procurement wants a formal DocuSign path, we can produce a two-part DocuSign: 1) startup enrollment (credits + T&Cs) and 2) committed-use MSA/Appendix. Otherwise we can do an inline PO/quote. I’ll draft a quote once Ava confirms the anchor run-rate.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions, Redwood Inference

Ben / Ava — thanks for the clarity. We’ll anchor the quote to the Expected (60M tokens / month) for the initial draft. Procurement (procurement@lumenix.com) is on this thread and expects to start commercial review the week of 3/2.

Request: please include the following in the draft quote/DocuSign packet: 
- Line items showing effective $/1M for the first 12 months and year 2 under a 24-month committed plan with the proposed rebates.
- Clear callouts on what features count as "included" vs add-on (dedicated capacity, VPC/private, premium SLA).
- Startup enrollment terms (3-month credit + 30% off months 4–9) and how credits apply to overages.
- A short appendix listing required compliance artifacts and expected turnaround for SOC2/DPA exchange.

If you can get a draft to us by 2/25 that would align well with our internal cadence.

We’re optimistic — thanks.

Samir
